<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/structure"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the whole recorded search of one attack run on one goal: its attempts with their metadata, their trace steps and their results, to draw how the attack progressed. Both `goal_index` and `run_id` are required. Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
